[burza_iskier].omen.text.t: The air thickens, your hair stands on end, and something crackles softly in your ears.

[grad].omen.text.t: The sky turns yellow, and a dry rattle comes from beyond the horizon.

[mgla_ciszy].omen.text.t: The birds fall silent, and a thick white damp creeps in from the marshes.

[mgla_poranna].omen.text.t: A white pall rises off the river, and the birds go quiet in the woods.

[noc_bez_gwiazd].omen.text.t: The stars go out one by one, as if someone were snuffing candles.

[przymrozek].omen.text.t: The air smells sharply of iron, and the grass stiffens with rime.

[ulewa].omen.text.t: The sky goes dark from the west, and the wind carries the smell of wet earth.

[upal].omen.text.t: The air stands still, and your shadow shrinks under your feet.

[wichura].omen.text.t: The branches start to creak, and the first gust rolls across the field.
